title: Cocycle law for compatible transport
statement: Under the hypotheses of the compatible-transport structure [def-weil-pbc-finite-local-model-compatible-transport], for any scheme W and three lifts a,b,c to U with equal composite to T, successive transport from a to b and b to c equals direct transport from a to c.

A representation of a sheaf on the small etale site gives compatible transport on a representing scheme

from.place: Yoneda comparison, then diagonal and cocycle laws of local representatives

proof.text:
Put R = Q ×_T U ×_T U, with its three maps to U. Since Q → U and
U → T are etale, R → T is etale. Its projection to Q is the universal point
above the first lift. Apply e inverse to that point to obtain a section s of
E on R. Compatibility identifies the first transport with the point obtained
from s above the second lift, and its subsequent transport with the point
obtained from s above the third lift. Direct transport also equals the third
point, so these transports coincide. Given arbitrary W, x, a, b, c, the maps
x.left, b, c have equal composites to T. The pullback universal property
therefore gives W → R whose composites are the given maps. Apply naturality
three times to pull back the universal equality. Functoriality of composition
then gives the displayed equality. Proof irrelevance identifies the equalities
of composites used as transport arguments. Empty schemes satisfy the same
universal properties; neither surjectivity nor nonemptiness is needed.

lean.statement: theorem finiteLocalModels_descentDatum_compatibility_transport_cocycle (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (U : T.Etale) (Q : U.left.FiniteEtale) (e : (E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙ uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj) (t : FiniteLocalModelCompatibleTransport T E U Q e) : ∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) (a b c : W ⟶ U.left) (hab : a ≫ U.hom = b ≫ U.hom) (hbc : b ≫ U.hom = c ≫ U.hom) (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk Q.obj.hom), t.transport b c hbc (t.transport a b hab x) = t.transport a c (hab.trans hbc) x
